reason: Machine lens, checked by assembling the shipping and bench (DEBUG_LIVES) layouts with and without the change in a scratch copy and diffing the listings. Opcodes: BCS, INC zp, BRA are all real 65SC12 opcodes (BRA is CMOS; render.6502 already uses it). Cycles: hot path (no carry) was BCC taken 3 (9E91->9E95, same page), now BCS not taken 2: 1 saved each time. Rare path was BCC 2 + INC zp 5 = 7, now BCS taken 3 (9E91->9EC8, same page) + INC 5 + BRA 3 (9ECA->9E93, same page) = 11. Bytes: BCC+INC 4 -> BCS+INC+BRA 6, so the code grows by 2 (the claim's -2). Branch ranges: BCS +&35, BRA -&37 (offset &C7), fine. Self-modifying: hazel_restore's operand moves with its label and the STA hazel_restore+1/+2 stores follow the label, so it still works; nothing else in src/ refers to these bytes and kop_next_page is a new, unique label. Everything after the window in bank 4 moves +2: the only branch whose page crossing changes is compact's BEQ gathered (9EFD/9EFF, stops crossing: a gain). Indexed tables that move by 2: ck_index (a3b2->a3b4; indices &4C/&4D, sprite 4 flipped lines 4/5, both &FF, now cross &A400) and straight_sprite_hi (a4e4->a4e6; sprites &1A/&1B now cross &A500) take a rare +1. ck_bank/ck_draw/ck_restore, straight_sprite_lo, sprite_column_count, sky_blk, wa_rows and sky_heights keep their crossing. Measured with pcprof on the bench layout (seed 1, 1500 passes, --unclobber) for both builds: game identical (logic and irq the same), render 23270.71 -> 23269.35 cycles a pass (-1.35). The window's BCS goes 4.355 -> 3.011, the stub costs 0.194+0.323, gathered saves 0.47, and straight_sprite_hi/ck_index change by +0.005/-0.005. So the 1 cycle per execution holds; the pass gain is 1.35 on seed 1, not the 2.0 claimed (that figure assumed 2.2 executions a pass; the bench has about 1.45). Shipping, gameplay (all GAMEPLAY_* + DITHER_HILLS), SKY_HELI=0 and DEBUG_FULLREDRAW builds all assemble with the change.
